title: Settings
lead: Your agents live on your own computer. Give them their own addresses and numbers, and connect them to your apps here.

pair.title: Pair a phone
pair.hint: Scan with your phone camera — no typing. The code works once and expires in 10 minutes. Then “Add to Home Screen” for an app-like experience.

brain.title: Brain
brain.hint: Almost any model works (through LiteLLM). To change the default, edit LLM_MODEL / LLM_API_KEY in .env or re-run ./dot.sh setup, then restart.

device.title: This device
device.hint: Memory, routines, identity and skills now live in each agent's profile under Team.

profiles.title: Model profiles
profiles.hint: Named LLM configs — point different agents at different models. “private” is meant for a local model (e.g. Ollama) so that agent never leaves this machine.
profiles.name: Name
profiles.baseUrl: Base URL (only for your own OpenAI-compatible server)
profiles.modelPh: provider/model — or choose a provider and tap “Show models”

secondLook.title: Second look
secondLook.hint: Before an agent emails, texts, posts or does anything else in your name, a quick check makes sure it's really what you asked. It can only make things safer — it'll ask you first or stop it, never skip a question.
